context: Inventory keys-only callers, add get_platform_names backed by the cached metadata without copying nested values, migrate the enumeration callers, and keep the existing mutation-isolation behavioral tests green.
description: From the 2026-08-09 adversarial review of PR #1644, deferred at merge without a tracker record. PlatformRegistry.get_all_platform_metadata deep-copies the entire nested metadata for roughly fifty platforms on every call (benchbox/core/platform_registry.py:634); the deepcopy is deliberate mutation isolation from PR #1644 and must stay for full-metadata consumers. However benchbox/cli/platform.py and benchbox/cli/database.py only call list(...keys()) to enumerate names, paying the full copy of every deployment_modes and libraries subtree on repeated CLI and MCP listing paths. Add a cached keys-only accessor named get_platform_names and migrate enumeration callers to it.

anti_patterns.instead: Copy only the key list into a fresh list.
anti_patterns.why: That defeats the purpose of the accessor.

anti_patterns.dont: Return the cached nested structure without a copy from the full-metadata API.
anti_patterns.instead: Keep the deepcopy for full-metadata consumers and add a names-only path.

preserves.behavior: Platform SDK imports remain lazy during enumeration.
Returned name ordering and content match the metadata key set.
get_all_platform_metadata keeps returning a mutation-isolated deep copy with an unchanged public shape.

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c "from benchbox.core.platform_registry import PlatformRegistry; assert hasattr(PlatformRegistry, 'get_platform_names')"
verifications.expected: Exits nonzero on the unfixed tree; exits 0 once the accessor lands.
Registry behavior including mutation isolation is unchanged.

verifications.description: CLI and MCP listing surfaces pass
verifications.expected: Enumeration surfaces list identical platform names.

verifications.command: uv run -- ruff check benchbox/core/platform_registry.py benchbox/cli benchbox/mcp

work_units.evidence: Repository-wide rg found four production keys-only callers: benchbox/cli/platform.py default/fallback enabled lists, benchbox/cli/database.py additional-platform enumeration, and benchbox/sql_compat/baseline_tool.py benchmark-gate enumeration. MCP resources/registry.py and tools/discovery.py require nested metadata values and remain on get_all_platform_metadata. Other callers likewise consume values. Added the omitted SQL-compat file to scope with an audited reason.
work_units.summary: Inventory every caller of get_all_platform_metadata and classify keys-only versus full-metadata usage

work_units.evidence: Added PlatformRegistry.get_platform_names returning a fresh list from the internal metadata cache without deepcopying nested values. Added a test proving ordering/content parity with get_all_platform_metadata keys and mutation isolation of the returned list. Scoped Ruff passed; registry behavioral suite exited 0.
work_units.summary: Add the cached get_platform_names accessor without copying nested metadata

MCP resource/discovery callers remain on full metadata because they consume nested values. Added ordering, fresh-list, and mocked-deepcopy negative controls. Ruff and ty passed; related registry/CLI/MCP suite: 962 passed; compat docs and DDL drift checks clean.
